comparison.objective: Reject an expired analyser kit into a tray and call a supervisor rather than loading it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Rule-aware object sorting and button actuation versus fine mechanical adjustment, tool reacquisition and physical response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Expired kit must never enter the analyser bay; full success is kit in the grey tray and supervisor called. Candidate uses dynamic mechanical limits and repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: This is a safety-policy compliance task, not dexterous mechanism commissioning.
